column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.92.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.92/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS
# v1.0.91 was TAGGED ONCE AT 8650800c887f6b1bca28b64caa3f7bb01d17f2f8 AND
# NEVER BUILT. The blocker was check-pr-age (scripts/verify_pr_age.sh),
# refusing on 6 of 7 repos it could not reach: andygmassey/CM044-PWG-Personal-
# Wiki, CM041-People-Graph, CM059-Ostler-Editor, CM031-PWG-Companion, HR015-
# Gaming-PC, and ostler-ai/ostler-assistant. CM051 #1930 (merged earlier the
# same day) made an unreachable, undeclared repo a hard failure rather than a
# silent pass, correctly, and the credential CI wires for those six
# (OSTLER_GH_TOKEN_ANDYGMASSEY) does not cover pull-request read on them --
# a scope gap, not a networking fault: a local `gh auth token --user
# andygmassey` reaches all six from a Mac. CM051 #1942 declares the six by
# name via PR_AGE_ALLOW_PARTIAL, the escape hatch #1930 itself provides for
# exactly this case, in both jobs that run check-pr-age. That credential's
# scope gap is not fixed by this cut; it is stated, not fixed, per #1942's
# own PR body.
# v1.0.92 carries v1.0.91's payload UNCHANGED: the daemon and hub-app re-pin
# to hub-v0.4.80 (ostler-assistant commit
# b014faf593123676e00fa1197360f5142081705e), three merged fixes (off-state
# toggle/slider track contrast, the daemon authenticating its own hop to the
# wiki instead of the browser's, and a doctest-CI-only wiki_proxy fence),
# plus the one fix that unblocks it. install.sh is untouched by #1942 (it
# touches only .github/workflows/cut.yml), so its blob is byte-identical to
# what v1.0.91 would have shipped.
# WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT A ROW
# The check-pr-age declaration (#1942) is cut MACHINERY, not shipped product
# behaviour, so it gets no BOM row of its own -- same precedent as v1.0.78
# carrying v1.0.77's row forward unchanged past the gate that could not
# measure it (that row's own header explains why a BOM row would be "a
# second, weaker statement of a thing already proved exactly").
what

OFF-STATE TOGGLE/SLIDER TRACK WAS INVISIBLE AGAINST ITS CARD (low contrast, --pc-bg-track-off / --pc-border-track-off tokens added). Verified present in the hub-v0.4.80 daemon's bundled web/dist CSS and absent from hub-v0.4.79's.

THE DAEMON'S HOP TO THE WIKI WAS UNAUTHENTICATED, USING THE BROWSER'S CREDENTIAL INSTEAD OF ITS OWN, CAUSING A BARE NGINX 401 ON THE PERSONAL WIKI TAB ON EVERY INSTALL. wiki_proxy.rs authenticates the daemon's own hop. Verified present via the new module's distinctive strings ("Ostler/0.1 (wiki_proxy)", "wiki is still starting up") in the hub-v0.4.80 Mach-O, absent (0 occurrences) from hub-v0.4.79's.
WIKI_PROXY DOC-COMMENT QUOTES BROKE THE DOCTEST CI LANE, fenced as text rather than Rust (tip of ostler-assistant main at cut-pin time, b014faf5). CI-only; no runtime behaviour change.

THE DAEMON PIN, MOVED AT ALL FIVE install.sh/gui/Makefile SITES. install.sh OSTLER_ASSISTANT_VERSION to 0.4.80 and DEFAULT_ASSISTANT_TARBALL_SHA256 to the published digest; gui/Makefile DAEMON_VERSION and DAEMON_SHA256 to the same. Both digests read from the published .sha256 sidecar and re-hashed independently, never typed. Split from CM051 #1939 into #1940 so the pin gate (cut-pin-is-actually-current) classifies this PR report rather than block: it touches no cuts/**/cut.env.

THE HUB APP PIN, SAME COMMIT, SEPARATE CAPABILITY BECAUSE IT IS A SEPARATE REPO AND A SEPARATE FAILURE. gui/Makefile HUB_APP_SHA256 names the Ostler.app bundle published for hub-v0.4.80; HUB_APP_TARBALL_NAME interpolates DAEMON_VERSION, so the hub app digest must move whenever the daemon one does or download-hub-app fails closed, exactly as it did for v1.0.81.
